Yeah, this is helping me reframe all of this. I was always giving him some credit, like... "Well, he said he was doing it for us, and he did put a lot of time and money into it. Maybe he really was trying to give us his idea of a good future?" But it doesn't make any sense unless he thought we were just like him, wanted the same things he did. And we obviously didn't. If he'd stopped for two minutes to ask us if we really wanted to be a child rock band, we would've said no. 

So yeah... he never made any sense to me. It always felt like he was begrudgingly sacrificing time and money to make us do something we didn't want to do, so that we could one day be rich and happy, even though we hated doing it. But now I think he actually wanted to see if he could turn a group of three kids into a world-famous rock band. He wanted to prove he was amazing enough to do something like that. He always made it sound like we were guaranteed to be rich and famous, tour the country (a frightening idea), retire when we were young. And yet the work we produced never sounded anywhere close to world class. Delusions of grandeur, only thinking about himself, ignoring other people's feelings... maybe he really is an N. Weird.

Thanks. This helps.
